headline: Talbot signs 1-year contract with Blue Jackets
title: Cam Talbot signs 1-year contract with Columbus Blue Jackets
summary: Cam Talbot signed a one-year, $950,000 contract with the Columbus Blue Jackets on Monday.
body:
<forge-entity title="Cam Talbot" slug="cam-talbot-8475660" code="player">Cam Talbot</forge-entity> signed a one-year, $950,000 contract with the Columbus Blue Jackets on Monday.

The goalie was 12-9-6 with a 3.19 goals-against average and .883 save percentage in 34 games (25 starts) for the Detroit Red Wings last season.

“Adding depth in net has been a priority for us so we are very excited to add Cam Talbot to our club,” Blue Jackets general manager Don Waddell said. “He is a big, smart, fundamentally sound goaltender who has won a lot of games in our league.  He is also a quality person, and we think he’ll be a great addition to our group.”

The 39-year-old, who was undrafted, is 278-204-53 with a 2.69 GAA, .911 save percentage and 33 shutouts in 567 regular-season games (533 starts) for the New York Rangers, Edmonton Oilers, Philadelphia Flyers, Calgary Flames, Minnesota Wild, Ottawa Senators, Los Angeles Kings and Red Wings. He is 16-18 with a 2.75 GAA, .915 save percentage and six shutouts in 36 Stanley Cup Playoff games (34 starts).

The addition of Talbot gives Columbus another veteran goalie entering training camp this week with <forge-entity title="Elvis Merzlikins" slug="elvis-merzlikins-8478007" code="player">Elvis Merzlikins</forge-entity> out indefinitely after having shoulder surgery on Aug. 17. Jet Greaves, who won the No. 1 job last season, and <forge-entity title="Pheonix Copley" slug="pheonix-copley-8477831" code="player">Pheonix Copley</forge-entity> are the other goalies on the Blue Jackets roster with NHL experience.
